<p>Engineering and running experiments are a key component of most PhDs in AI. While there are plenty of more theoretical topics that are often limited to smaller scale experimentation, the trend has definitely been to scale up models, datasets and experiments. Thus, being an effective engineer and setting up experiments in an efficient way can be a crucial element of being successful during a PhD. In this article, I want to share some lessons I learned on effective experimentation.</p>
<p>The post <a href="https://davidstutz.de/the-importance-of-effectively-experimenting-in-an-ai-phd/">The Importance of Effectively Experimenting in an AI PhD</a> appeared first on <a href="https://davidstutz.de">David Stutz</a>.</p>
